column1: # The calendar of the appendices (progetti/appendici/appendici/calendario.tex, pp. 25-26, PDF 3026-3027),
# by hand from the table of the months and the list of the annual feasts. tipo mese: n the Roman number of
# the table, nome the Babylonian name (prefLabel), antico the old name with its reference, solare the solar
# months, macedone the Macedonian name. tipo festa: nome as printed in italics, altri the other names
# printed (separated by |), mese the month (its Roman number), giorno the day(s) as printed, riferimenti
# as printed (the book of a bare reference is the one before), anche the same concept in the indices and
# the dictionary (note.<n>, temi.<n>, voce:<slug>). parole: the words of the CEI text that name the month
